content: {"like":["Values high-quality audio and visual presentation, especially 5.1 surround and remastered releases","Prefers comprehensive special features and bonus content","Appreciates strong performances and well-crafted scripts","Enjoys films that explore social issues and complex characters","Enjoys nostalgic homages and genre blends like screwball comedy and musical elements"],"dislike":["Dislikes poor release quality, such as VHS transfers and mediocre video","Criticizes packaging and physical defects like shoddy hubs and residue on discs","Rejects minimal or absent bonus features, especially lacking subtitles or trailers","Avoids content with heavy sexual references or raunchy elements for younger audiences","Dislikes clichéd plots and excessive profanity or drug use"]}
